title: Lumenfold Labs acquires Pinecone Ridge Software
text: Lumenfold Labs announced it has acquired Pinecone Ridge Software, a startup building data pipelines, for an undisclosed sum. About 40 Pinecone Ridge engineers will join Lumenfold and migrate their workloads onto Lumenfold's platform in the coming quarter.

title: Lumenfold Labs opens 12 engineering roles
text: Lumenfold Labs is hiring across platform, data and infrastructure, with 12 open roles posted this week, signalling a larger engineering organisation next year.

title: Marlowe & Finch Logistics raises $60M Series B
text: Marlowe & Finch Logistics closed a $60M Series B round led by Granite Peak Capital to expand its freight network into northern Europe and invest in automation.

title: Marlowe Finch Logistics names new CTO
text: Marlowe Finch Logistics appointed Odalys Brandt as chief technology officer, replacing the retiring incumbent. Brandt previously ran platform engineering at a regional rail operator.

title: Vantara Freight announces layoffs of 8% of staff
text: Vantara Freight said it is cutting about 8% of its workforce as demand softens, with layoffs concentrated in sales and operations.

title: Zenith Parcel Co. acquires Boreal Routing
text: Zenith Parcel Co. has agreed to acquire Boreal Routing in an all-cash deal expected to close early next year.

title: Harbor City marathon causes road closures this Sunday
text: Several downtown roads will be closed on Sunday for the annual marathon. Residents are advised to use public transport.

title: Usage-based pricing continues to spread across software
text: A new survey finds more B2B vendors are adopting usage-based pricing, with customer success teams increasingly measured on net revenue retention.

title: Nimbus Orchard raises $12M Series A
text: Nimbus Orchard, a seed-stage agtech company, raised a $12M Series A to expand its sensor network.

title: Kestrel Dynamics appoints new CEO
text: Kestrel Dynamics appointed Mara Ionescu as chief executive officer as the founder moves to an advisory role.
